不想错过我的任何照片吗？关注我的帖子收藏

V3

两个 v3 版本（有高档和无高档）需要我开发的自定义节点集合。并且可以通过“安装缺少的自定义节点“ComfyUI-Manager 的功能。节点集合也可以通过管理器 Manuel 或通过 git clone 下载。

https://github.com/BlackVortexAI/ComfyUI-BVortexNodes


V3版本如何运作？

1. 指定图像所在的文件夹

2（仅限 Upscale 版本）定义不应将哪个分辨率的图像发送到 Upscale（数字定义最小尺寸）

3.（仅限高档版本）调整您的通量参数。如果需要，也可以更换高档型。目前已配置 1 Step UltimateSDUpscale。

4. 开始运行。所有处理后的图像都保存在子文件夹“/dataset/[resolution]/”中，其中配置的zero_padding和分辨率为名称，为png，标题为txt。

V2

似乎有些人在通过缺失节点安装 LogicUtils 节点时遇到困难。如果是这种情况，只需搜索“LogicUtils”或直接通过 url 安装。https://github.com/aria1th/ComfyUI-LogicUtils

此工作流程用于通过 Florence2 为文件夹中的图像添加字幕，并根据其最小分辨率 (256/512/756/1024) 对它们进行排序。图片和标题以连续编号和分辨率保存在相应文件夹中[count]_[res]_00001_.png

然后可以使用这些文件夹，例如在https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-FluxTrainer

o.en:
Don't want to miss any of my pictures? Follow myPost Collection

V3

The two v3 versions (with upscale and without upscale) require a custom node collection developed by me. And can be installed with the "Install Missing Custom Nodes" Feature from ComfyUI-Manager. The node collection can also be downloaded via the manager Manuel or via git clone.

https://github.com/BlackVortexAI/ComfyUI-BVortexNodes


How does the V3 version work?

1. Specify the folder in which your images are located

2 (Upscale version only) Define from which resolution images should not be sent to Upscale (the number defines the minimum size)

3. (Upscale version only) Adjust your flux parameters. If desired, the upscale type can also be exchanged. Currently the 1 Step UltimateSDUpscale is configured.

4. Start the run. All processed images are saved in the subfolder “/dataset/[resolution]/ with the configured zero_padding and resolution as name, as png and the caption as txt.

V2

It seems that some people have difficulties installing the LogicUtils nodes via missing nodes. If this is the case just search for “LogicUtils” or install directly via url.https://github.com/aria1th/ComfyUI-LogicUtils

This workflow is used to caption images from a folder via Florence2 and sort them according to their min resolution (256/512/756/1024). The images and the caption are saved in the corresponding folder with a consecutive number and the resolution [count]_[res]_00001_.png

The folders can then be used e.g. athttps://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-FluxTrainer
